note: E85 — adversarial fixture: pairs designed to make each E84 rule fire WRONGLY. Every pair is consistent (contradiction=false). Same surface shapes as the holdout contradictions: same measurement frame with different numbers, opposed comparison words around a shared quantity, same modal with opposed polarity, universal against negative-universal, swapped predicate-argument order, dictionary antonyms spanning the pair, one side negating what the other asserts. None contradicts.

pairs.a: The batch weighed 200 kg before drying.
pairs.b: The batch weighed 176 kg after drying.

pairs.a: The inlet gauge reads 3.2 bar at startup.
pairs.b: The inlet gauge reads 2.9 bar at shutdown.

pairs.a: The older press runs slower than the new one.
pairs.b: The new press runs faster than the older one.

pairs.a: The standby generator is louder than the main unit.
pairs.b: The main unit runs more quietly than the standby generator.

pairs.a: Operators may stop the line for a jam.
pairs.b: Operators may keep the line running when it is clear.

pairs.a: The valve must stay open during transfer.
pairs.b: The drain valve must stay closed during transfer.

pairs.a: All sensors passed calibration this morning.
pairs.b: No sensor failed calibration this morning.

pairs.a: Every pallet was scanned at the dock.
pairs.b: No pallet left the dock unscanned.

pairs.a: The technician inspects the valve daily.
pairs.b: The valve is inspected by the technician daily.

pairs.a: The pump feeds the boiler during startup.
pairs.b: During startup, the boiler is fed by the pump.

pairs.a: The system switches from heating to cooling at noon.
pairs.b: Cooling starts when heating ends at noon.

pairs.a: The pump must not run dry.
pairs.b: Running the pump dry is prohibited.

pairs.a: Do not open the panel while energized.
pairs.b: Opening the energized panel is forbidden.
